{{Quote|We're on remote autopilot until we clear the atmosphere. Then I aim this brick for sun, fire the single-shot booster, and send it to oblivion. This cab returns to the surface and I go get drunk, secure in the knowledge that the world's safe from a half-million tons of unwanted refuse.|Perla, to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="SW7" />}}
A '''garbage barge''' was a type of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] designed to carry unwanted refuse.<ref name="SW7" />

==History==
{{Quote|I'm good at what I do, but putting garbage barges through evasive maneuvers isn't typically all in a day's work.|Perla, to Han Solo|<ref name="SW8">[[Star Wars (2013) 8|''Star Wars'' (2013) 8]]</ref>}}
The [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] started its life as a garbage barge retrofitted with [[Prison/Legends|holding cells]] and a makeshift [[Medical bay/Legends|medbay]].<ref name="ML">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>

The [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Didi Oddo]] compared the [[Sleek Cruiser Inn]], a dilapidated [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located on [[Grand Eucer Street]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]], to a garbage barge.<ref name="TDG">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] considered his hometown of [[New Tayana]], a [[City-ship/Legends|space city]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the polluted planet [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], to be a garbage barge.<ref name="BvB">{{TCWComicCite|6.46|Bane vs ...Bane?}}</ref>

The garbage barge ''[[FFD204A/3254-N]]'' was operated by [[Perla]] for the [[Imperial Center Sanitation Department]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SW7" />
